optimizationRound.method: phase profiling (WAIFU_TRUFOR_PROFILE), paired interleaved A/B runs, parity gates before adoption
adopted: per-shape MLX compile of the forward graph with the noise body outside the compiled graph (memory-bounding evals preserved)
decoder linear_fuse kernel pre-sliced into four contiguous per-part weights at load

FP16 weights and activations by default with FP32 islands: every LayerNorm, every BN including the DnCNN BN rows, and the whole detection head; WAIFU_TRUFOR_PRECISION=fp32 keeps the strict validation path
noise tile default 512 -> 1024 (measured ~3-9% at 1024x768, per-tile evals bound memory)
rejected: custom direct 3x3 conv Metal kernel: measured 92-96 ms per layer versus 26 ms for MLX implicit-GEMM FP16 (weight reuse does not amortize at 64 channels); removed
joint batching beyond the 1M-pixel worker envelope: measured 1.364 s/img versus 1.304 s/img single at 1024x768; envelope reverted
query chunk removal and chunk size changes: neutral in paired runs (ratio 0.992)
